svg.text: ÉCLOS — REFILLABLE DUO BLUSH COMPACT, SECTIONS AND HINGE

My original compact at true scale (×6.875: 55.0 across the flats, as the round ÉCLOS compact). Exterior kept; inside: bonded insert, two tinplate refill godets on magnets, magnetic closure, bonded mirror, 3-knuckle pin hinge.
A–A plane x = 0, along the rib between the pans: front ← → hinge scale 3:1
B–B plane y = 0 (through both refills): left ← → right (ÉCLOS face) scale 3:1
C x = 0: lid knuckle, rib, pin 8:1
D x = 3.5: base knuckle, lid boss 8:1
Pin Ø0.8 stainless, pressed in the base knuckles; Ø0.9 bore in the lid knuckle, 0.050 radial measured.
Barrel Ø2.4, axis 0.3 inside the back face, shows 0.9 behind it (original barrel: 0.91).
Slots Ø2.7: 0.150 radial measured each way, 0.15 axial. Rib (base) and boss (lid) keep ≥ 0.75 of wall.
Lid drawn at 108.0°, the last clear 0.5° step; dashed = closed.
The base's back edge is relieved by the lid's back strip swept to 100°.
Stepping the lid in 0.5°, it first meets uncut base at 108.5°: the stop.
Min wall, sampled: base / lid / insert / godet
base / lid: zinc die-cast, gold PVD (proposed)
PARTS (proposed materials; mass at assumed densities)
Lid with relief and mirror recess
